title: Unable to access shift handover log system
description: Could not load the shift handover log page — realised mid-way that the VPN session had timed out. Self-resolved.

title: Unable to access shift schedule on internal portal
description: Cannot load the resident shift schedule page on the internal portal. Page returns a blank screen after login. — Draft abandoned; resolved by clearing browser cache.

title: Unable to access hospital intranet clinical decision support module
description: Cannot load the clinical decision support module from the intranet portal. Suspected browser cache issue — cleared cache and it resolved itself before submitting.

title: Unable to access radiology image viewer on ward terminal
description: The radiology image viewer keeps timing out when I try to load CT scans from the ward terminal. Tried refreshing — realized the VPN session had expired, reconnected and it resolved itself.

title: Unable to access patient record lookup in hospital information system
description: Cannot pull up patient record via HIS terminal in ED bay 3. Tried restarting the browser — same issue. Possibly a session timeout or permission config problem. (Draft abandoned — realised I just needed to re-login with shift credentials.)

title: Cannot access ED patient scheduling module
description: The ED scheduling module is not loading after login. Attempted refresh but no change — realised this was a browser cache issue, resolved locally.

title: Lab result notification not appearing in patient record
description: Lab result alert for a patient was not visible in the EMR notification panel. Checked further and found the result had been filed under a slightly different patient ID — issue identified without escalation needed.
